sample.summary: Source files src/acc/backends/claude.py and src/acc/runner.py modified to support retryable errors and single-entry batch retries have corresponding test coverage in tests/test_claude_backend.py and tests/test_runner.py.
Commit only changes how a path is resolved (from resolve() to absolute()) with a comment explaining the behavior change; no new behavior needs testing as this is a refactor of path resolution logic.

Source file src/acc/backends/claude.py modified to increase MAX_TURNS from 2 to 4 and add ENV_OVERRIDES for MAX_THINKING_TOKENS has corresponding test updates in tests/test_claude_backend.py verifying both the argv flags and environment variable handling.

Source file src/acc/backends/claude.py modified to add SETTINGS constant and disable extended thinking has corresponding test updates in tests/test_claude_backend.py verifying the settings are correctly applied.
New source file src/acc/mcp_server.py with 186 lines exposing checks as MCP tools has comprehensive test coverage in tests/test_mcp.py with tests for list, run, add, update, and promote operations.
New source files src/acc/cli.py, src/acc/gate.py, and src/acc/log.py with CLI commands and gate logic have corresponding test coverage in tests/test_cli.py and tests/test_gate.py.
New source files src/acc/grading.py (226 lines) and src/acc/ops.py (125 lines) with check grading and operations have corresponding tests in tests/test_grading.py covering grading workflows.
Commit adds Python backend implementations and runner infrastructure with corresponding test files for claude backend and runner functionality.
New source file src/acc/pushrange.py with 203 lines of functionality has comprehensive test coverage in tests/test_pushrange.py with 159 lines of tests covering various push scenarios.
Commit adds git helper functions and git push command parser with corresponding test file (test_gitcmd.py) covering the parser behavior.
New source file src/acc/secrets.py with 90 lines implementing secret scanning has corresponding tests in tests/test_secrets_globs.py covering scan_diff, redaction, and pattern matching behavior.
Commit adds check file format, configuration loading, and validation logic with corresponding test files for checks and configuration functionality.
Commit adds project scaffolding (gitignore, README, pyproject.toml, documentation) and base module initialization with no functional code requiring tests.
